challenge_focus: A three-field version bump for an npm release. Round 1 raised three findings, all of the "the packet cannot show me the out-of-band fact" family; two are structural (a landing packet must equal its candidate, so a rehearsal transcript or registry state can never be inside it) and one names checks that were then run out of band: the registry reports 0.16.0 as latest, 0.17.0 returns 404, and no ccl-skills-v0.17.0 tag exists on the remote. Attack what the diff itself can settle: whether exactly three version fields moved and nothing else in those two JSON files was reordered or reformatted; whether package.json and package-lock.json are left mutually consistent; whether anything outside the version fields and this release evidence directory was touched; and whether minor rather than patch is the wrong call given the closure change.
